items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I met a guitar player, he was playing with Oscar Petterford, the bass player. Well in Germany, in Baden-Baden, on this television show, there was a play, you know, where we had been rehearsing, and they kept telling us they had a trio that was going to be on the show with us too

ctx.x: A lot of people say he had the best band here for many years. For many years.

Yeah, he had the best band for many, many years. He had a real good band. And I'll tell you what I would, what I would like to get back to, uh, England again. For him. For, for. For one thing I wanted, I wanted to, you know, the musicians to know that how much these, these musicians over in Europe, not only England, are interested in the New Orleans music. And they actually, they, they have it at heart. And good as they play. Now we met some musicians, they actually play very, I mean they play really good. But…
